message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on facts. Facts: Defendant Tang signed car rental contract, rented car for month, then after period, continued to "骗租" the car by paying partial rent, i.e., fraudulently continuing rental. Then in July 2010, used the car as collateral to get a loan of 30,000 yuan via fish (someone). So he used the car as collateral illegally (maybe fraud). The car was recovered and returned to victim. Value of car 50,500 yuan. He was arrested.

Potential crimes: Fraud (诈骗) for deceiving the rental company to continue renting without paying full rent? Also possibly "非法占有" maybe theft? But he didn't steal; he used the car as collateral to get loan, which is fraud (using false pledge). Could be "诈骗" (fraud) and "非法占有" maybe "诈骗" covers both. Also "伪造、变造国家机关证件" not relevant. "受贿" not relevant. "破坏电信设施" not relevant.

Thus likely "诈骗". Also maybe "非法占有" but Chinese criminal law: Using false pledge to obtain loan is "诈骗" (fraud). Also "非法占有" is theft. He didn't steal; he had possession via rental contract but then fraudulently extended. So main crime: 诈骗.

Check if multiple crimes: Could be "诈骗" and "非法占有"? The facts: He continued to rent the car by paying partial rent, i.e., deceiving the rental company. That's fraud. Then he used the car as collateral to get loan, which is also fraud (maybe "非法占有" of the car? He didn't have ownership, but used as pledge). So likely just one crime: 诈骗.

Thus answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>
